  longer without tiring, and runs on the cheapest profile that fits its task

  profiles on one client draw from one headroom, so check

  writer per file; a NEW slice gets a fresh worker, a fix round returns to the
  worker and the reviewer who hold its context. Spawn under a role NAME:
